assets.name: Orbit mouse
assets.description: A rounded top-view mouse with cupped ears, tapered snout, engraved flank lines and a curled tail.

assets.name: Dart mouse
assets.description: A slender top-view mouse with small swept ears, a long nose and a looped tail.

assets.name: Halo mouse
assets.description: A compact top-view mouse with oversized sculpted ears, a pointed muzzle and a coiled tail.

assets.name: Capuchin
assets.description: A seated capuchin token with a heart-shaped facial mask, grasping hands and a curling tail; facing north.

assets.name: Macaque
assets.description: A broad-headed macaque with wide ear bowls, a sculpted face mask and articulated hands; facing north.

assets.name: Elephant
assets.description: An overhead elephant with fan-shaped ears, engraved skin contours, tusks and a north-facing trunk.

assets.name: Fox
assets.description: A pointed-eared fox with angular cheek contours and a curled brush tail, seen from above.

assets.name: Touring coupe
assets.description: A top-down touring coupe with a tapered bonnet, panoramic glass and fine coachwork lines.

assets.name: Field rover
assets.description: A top-down field rover with a square chassis, roof ribs and a panoramic windscreen.

assets.name: Lattice board
assets.description: A five-by-five lattice grid. Playable area begins at 56,56 with 80-unit cells.

assets.name: Island board
assets.description: A five-by-five islands grid. Playable area begins at 56,56 with 80-unit cells.

assets.name: Circuit board
assets.description: A five-by-five circuit grid. Playable area begins at 56,56 with 80-unit cells.

assets.name: Target beacon
assets.description: A concentric target marker with a four-point centre.

assets.name: Meeting point
assets.description: An octagonal meeting-point marker with paired directional chevrons.
